metadata.title: Pertuzumab, Trastuzumab and Docetaxel Therapy – 21 day cycle
metadata.indication: HER2-positive metastatic or unresectable locally recurrent breast cancer
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Source audit and scenario cases in validation/breast-expansion-v08416/advanced. Not clinical approval.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
audit_limitations: Source hepatic / boundary ambiguities are explicit review actions.
Independent clinical and pharmacy validation pending.
Educational / software source reconciliation is not consultant, pharmacy or clinical-use authorisation.

source_monitoring.echo_baseline: LVEF assessment before starting HER2-directed treatment; see specific source wording.
source_monitoring.echo_ongoing: ECHO/MUGA every 12 weeks and at completion; consider every 4–8 weeks if cardiac impairment.
source_monitoring.timing_caveat: Cycle 1 is baseline. Later cycle landmarks assume uninterrupted 21-day cycles; elapsed 12-week intervals govern after delays.
source_monitoring.disease_imaging: Individual treatment plan and consultant direction; no universal fixed CT interval in these regimen PDFs.
source_monitoring.other_pathways: DEXA may be indicated by a separate endocrine/ovarian-suppression pathway, not automatically by this HER2 regimen.
source_monitoring.bloods_regular: FBC, renal and liver profile before each cycle.
source_monitoring.ongoing_count_gap: No explicit ongoing ANC/platelet modification table. Do not import thresholds from TCH or substitute baseline ANC for an ongoing clearance decision.

metadata.schedule_summary: IV pertuzumab, IV trastuzumab and docetaxel every 21 days. Docetaxel duration is reviewed separately; the two HER2 antibodies may continue after chemotherapy stops while beneficial and tolerated.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the current NCCP source. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

renal_input.reason: Retain exact measured creatinine clearance so decimal gaps between the source bands are surfaced for review rather than rounded into a dose band.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded action was triggered by the supplied values. Unassessed domains and the full prescribing review remain outstanding.

output_templates.contraindicated: Do not administer the affected component(s); review the findings and exact regimen context.
output_templates.discontinue: Discontinue the affected component(s) identified below and obtain treating-clinician review.

output_templates.delay: Delay the affected component(s) pending source-defined recovery and review.
output_templates.dose_reduce: A component-specific dose modification applies; verify the original and current doses before prescribing.

action.recommendation: Hold pertuzumab and trastuzumab for current LVEF<50% AND fall≥10 percentage points from baseline. Repeat LVEF within 3 weeks; no improvement or further decline requires consultant/cardiology review and consideration of discontinuation. This NCCP00204 criterion differs from 00507; do not substitute another regimen threshold.

rules.explanation: Hold pertuzumab and trastuzumab for current LVEF<50% AND fall≥10 percentage points from baseline. Repeat LVEF within 3 weeks; no improvement or further decline requires consultant/cardiology review and consideration of discontinuation. This NCCP00204 criterion differs from 00507; do not substitute another regimen threshold.

action.recommendation: Review the measured LVEF and baseline change using this regimen’s exact hold criterion. Missing context is unassessed; an isolated concerning result is not clearance.

rules.explanation: Review the measured LVEF and baseline change using this regimen’s exact hold criterion. Missing context is unassessed; an isolated concerning result is not clearance.

action.recommendation: Symptomatic heart failure: discontinue and refer for urgent cardiac assessment.

rules.explanation: Symptomatic heart failure: discontinue and refer for urgent cardiac assessment.

action.recommendation: Grade 4 hypersensitivity: discontinue the implicated treatment and manage urgently.

rules.explanation: Grade 4 hypersensitivity: discontinue the implicated treatment and manage urgently.

action.recommendation: Interrupt and urgently assess a severe infusion reaction; the source grade-4 discontinuation rule must not be relabelled grade 3.

action.recommendation: Required cardiac results are missing or overdue. Arrange assessment and a documented treatment decision; never assume normal function.

rules.explanation: Required cardiac results are missing or overdue. Arrange assessment and a documented treatment decision; never assume normal function.

action.recommendation: Validated HER2 positivity is required. Reconcile testing and regimen choice.

rules.explanation: Validated HER2 positivity is required. Reconcile testing and regimen choice.

action.recommendation: At treatment initiation, baseline LVEF below 50% does not meet eligibility; withhold pending cardiac/specialist review. Historical baseline must not be substituted for the ongoing current measurement.

rules.explanation: At treatment initiation, baseline LVEF below 50% does not meet eligibility; withhold pending cardiac/specialist review. Historical baseline must not be substituted for the ongoing current measurement.

action.recommendation: Clinically significant cardiac disease is a source caution / exclusion. Reconcile the individual cardiac plan before administration.

rules.explanation: Clinically significant cardiac disease is a source caution / exclusion. Reconcile the individual cardiac plan before administration.

action.recommendation: Severe dyspnoea at rest requires urgent review and is a trastuzumab product contraindication.

rules.explanation: Severe dyspnoea at rest requires urgent review and is a trastuzumab product contraindication.

action.recommendation: Stop pertuzumab if trastuzumab is discontinued.

rules.explanation: Stop pertuzumab if trastuzumab is discontinued.

action.recommendation: Interval ≥6 weeks: reload pertuzumab 840 mg IV; IV trastuzumab reload 8 mg/kg, then 6 mg/kg every 21 days. Confirm history, current cardiac review and observation. Do not reset prior chemotherapy reductions.

rules.explanation: Interval ≥6 weeks: reload pertuzumab 840 mg IV; IV trastuzumab reload 8 mg/kg, then 6 mg/kg every 21 days. Confirm history, current cardiac review and observation. Do not reset prior chemotherapy reductions.

action.recommendation: Less than six weeks between administrations: usual maintenance antibody doses as soon as clinically appropriate; check source schedule and reset appointments with the team.

rules.explanation: Less than six weeks between administrations: usual maintenance antibody doses as soon as clinically appropriate; check source schedule and reset appointments with the team.

action.recommendation: Severe hepatic impairment / significant hepatic dysfunction is a source chemotherapy exclusion. Do not administer affected chemotherapy; review the exact component and any HER2-only plan separately.

rules.explanation: Severe hepatic impairment / significant hepatic dysfunction is a source chemotherapy exclusion. Do not administer affected chemotherapy; review the exact component and any HER2-only plan separately.

action.recommendation: Acute FN requires urgent assessment and withholding chemotherapy. This source has no ongoing FN dose table; do not import a numeric reduction from another regimen.

rules.explanation: Acute FN requires urgent assessment and withholding chemotherapy. This source has no ongoing FN dose table; do not import a numeric reduction from another regimen.

action.recommendation: The actual current docetaxel dose is already below the source reference dose. Do not re-escalate automatically; reconcile previous reductions and the next action with oncology / pharmacy.

rules.explanation: The actual current docetaxel dose is already below the source reference dose. Do not re-escalate automatically; reconcile previous reductions and the next action with oncology / pharmacy.

action.recommendation: At treatment initiation current LVEF below 50% does not meet eligibility. Withhold antibodies and obtain cardiac/specialist review before starting.

rules.explanation: At treatment initiation current LVEF below 50% does not meet eligibility. Withhold antibodies and obtain cardiac/specialist review before starting.

action.recommendation: Unrecognised assessment stage: select baseline or ongoing. Independent safety findings still apply; do not infer a valid stage.

rules.explanation: Unrecognised assessment stage: select baseline or ongoing. Independent safety findings still apply; do not infer a valid stage.

action.recommendation: Unrecognised treatment phase: confirm combination treatment or antibody-only continuation. Do not select a chemotherapy dose from an invalid phase.

rules.explanation: Unrecognised treatment phase: confirm combination treatment or antibody-only continuation. Do not select a chemotherapy dose from an invalid phase.

action.recommendation: Establish whether this low baseline value is an initiation result or historical. Obtain the current LVEF and treatment stage; no automatic ongoing hold can be based on an old result alone.

rules.explanation: Establish whether this low baseline value is an initiation result or historical. Obtain the current LVEF and treatment stage; no automatic ongoing hold can be based on an old result alone.

action.recommendation: Interrupt the implicated infusion and assess/manage the reaction under the local emergency policy. Confirm culprit medicine and severity before any restart; a prior resolved reaction is not the same as a current reaction.

rules.explanation: Interrupt the implicated infusion and assess/manage the reaction under the local emergency policy. Confirm culprit medicine and severity before any restart; a prior resolved reaction is not the same as a current reaction.

action.recommendation: Current antibody infusion reaction: interrupt or slow and assess according to severity/local policy; treat symptoms and monitor. Consultant decides whether and how to restart after recovery.

rules.explanation: Current antibody infusion reaction: interrupt or slow and assess according to severity/local policy; treat symptoms and monitor. Consultant decides whether and how to restart after recovery.

treatment_phases.duration_text: Source minimum six cycles if tolerated; review after six–eight cycles or earlier for toxicity. Antibodies can continue separately.

indications.description: Adult metastatic or locally recurrent unresectable HER2-positive disease without prior anti-HER2 therapy or chemotherapy for metastatic disease.
